title: A Survey on the Real Power of ChatGPT

bias_targets.methodology: Reviewing external studies that demonstrate ChatGPT's strong performance and preference skew towards English compared to other languages.
Reviewing studies that investigate the model's sensitivity to the order of labels in a prompt, specifically tracking its higher probability of selecting labels placed at earlier positions.
Surveying longitudinal research that tracks the political orientation (e.g., left-leaning, neutral, right-leaning) of ChatGPT's outputs over several months across multiple languages.

bias_targets.target: Racial, Gender, Cultural, and Geographic bias
bias_targets.methodology: Referencing broad taxonomy studies that classify various demographic, linguistic, and cultural biases present in the training data and outputs of large language models.
